NewsArticle.Title: Donation
NewsArticle.Content:
The terrorist attacks on September 11 strike the heart of people throughout the entire world. The loss of innocent lives is a tragedy felt by all.
Nexon is donating 5% of all subscription revenue from all games to the September 11th Fund from September 11 through October 11th.
While we cannot know the pain that their victims and their families are currently suffering, we hope that they know that our thoughts and prayers are with them.
If you wish to aid the victims and their families, we suggest donating to charity organizations or emergency relief funds such as the September 11th Fund, which has been established by the United Way and the New York Community Trust. You can find more information about the September 11th Fund at: https://www.uwnyc.com/epledge/sept11.cfm
Every contribution, no matter how small, will certainly help and support needed services for the victims and their families.
